confirmed_errata.finding: Damping classification uses Γ versus ω0/2, inconsistent with ODE x¨+Γx˙+ω0²x; correct boundary Γ=2ω0.
9.2 subquestion c absent; labels a,b,d,e preserved.
Fifth problem printed Problem 5; map to 10.5 retaining original label.
Cover Exam1 although OCW catalog Practice Final Exam1. Q5 cover18 points, body p12 20 points; subparts total18.
Only 3 problems, each25pts, total75; do not invent fourth.
Printed ω(k)=T/(ma) sin(ka/2) has wrong units; prior discrete relation gives ω²=4T/(ma)sin²(ka/2), ω=2sqrt(T/(ma))|sin(ka/2)|.
Envelope/carrier preliminary expression uses vg inside carrier; phase propagation requires k0x−ω0t, separate from envelope t−x/vg.
